verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions first-party integrations with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK. The documented integrations are data sources (Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion), and the MCP server targets AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, Cline). Neither is an agent-framework integration, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop the memory layer into agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the Vercel AI SDK via documented first-party integrations
